source.author: stat
source.text: iamque aberant terris, quantum Cortynia currunt spicula, caeruleo gravidam cum Iuppiter imbri ipsa super nubem ratis armamenta Pelasgae sistit agens; inde horror aquis, et raptus ab omni sole dies miscet tenebras, quis protinus unda concolor; obnixi lacerant cava nubila venti diripiuntque fretum, nigris redit umida tellus verticibus, totumque notis certantibus aequor pendet et arquato iamiam prope sidera dorso frangitur, incertae nec iam prior impetus alno, sed labat exstantem rostris modo gurgite in imo, nune caelo Tritona ferens, nee robora prosunt semideum heroum, puppemque insana flagellat arbor et instabili procumbens pondere curvas raptat aquas, remique eadunt in peetus inanes.
source.text_original: iamque aberant terris, quantum Cortynia currunt / spicula, caeruleo gravidam cum Iuppiter imbri / ipsa super nubem ratis armamenta Pelasgae / sistit agens; inde horror aquis, et raptus ab omni / sole dies miscet tenebras, quis protinus unda / concolor; obnixi lacerant cava nubila venti / diripiuntque fretum, nigris redit umida tellus / verticibus, totumque notis certantibus aequor / pendet et arquato iamiam prope sidera dorso / frangitur, incertae nec iam prior impetus alno, / sed labat exstantem rostris modo gurgite in imo, / nune caelo Tritona ferens, nee robora prosunt / semideum heroum, puppemque insana flagellat / arbor et instabili procumbens pondere curvas / raptat aquas, remique eadunt in peetus inanes.
source.text_english: and now they were far from land, as far as Cretian javelins fly, when Jupiter, heavy with the blue rain, sets the Pelasgian ship’s tackle on the cloud itself, driving it onward; then comes horror upon the waters, and day, snatched from every sun, mingles darkness, and the wave is at once of one color with it; the winds, straining, tear the hollow clouds apart and strip the sea, the wet earth returns with black whirlings, and the whole expanse hangs with contending signs and is now, almost, broken by its curved back near the stars; and the uncertain bark no longer has its former force, but staggers, now in the deepest whirlpool, now carrying Triton to the sky, and no strength helps the demigod heroes, while a maddened tree lashes the stern and, falling with unstable weight, drags the curved waters along; the oars drop useless against their breasts.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: iam placidis ratis exstat aquis, quam gurgite ab imo et Thetis et magnis Nereus socer erigit ulnis.
reuse.text_original: iam placidis ratis exstat aquis, quam gurgite ab imo / et Thetis et magnis Nereus socer erigit ulnis.
reuse.text_english: Now the raft stands above the calm waters, which Thetis and Nereus, her great father-in-law, lift with their arms from the deep abyss.
